The old contacts are interior and remain feasible. They give the limsup bounded by the smallest contact coefficient. Exact continuation puts every new minimizer eventually in compact neighborhoods contained in the corresponding old fiber interiors. At those marks the old objective is nonnegative, and continuity and a fixed-base subsequence give the matching liminf.
The common positive contact value E_i and profile f_i can be pulled out of the minimum. Combining −D/(NM) and −D/(2M) gives −(N+2)D/(2NM); all signed shape terms retain their signs.

For a frozen old norm, A_i(t)=1. The old groups transfer to the unnormalized energy power because replacing the normalized parameter by ε M^(−1/N) gives the same old thresholds and old margins. Marked continuity and compactness still localize minimizers, and the uniform unnormalized power expansion gives the asserted derivative.

Checked an invariant one-interval homothety [−(1−ht),1−ht] with ε in (0,√3). The exact center margin is α_i(t)=εht. Using N=M=E_i=2, C=2h, D=2h and J_i^cov=6h gives exactly the same coefficient for either sign of h.
